benchmarkName: OSM 3D Renderer — Node.js CPU & Memory Benchmark Suite

metricDefinitions.geojsonParseAndClassifyMs: Wall-clock CPU time (ms) in LocalGeoJsonProvider.parseGeoJson to classify OSM tags, project WGS84 coordinates to local meters, clip to region bounds, and extract pre-chaining topologySource.
metricDefinitions.infrastructureGraphBuildMs: Wall-clock CPU time (ms) in buildInfrastructureGraph to construct RoadNetwork, RailwayNetwork, and CrossModalAnalyzer connectivity relations.
metricDefinitions.graphToRendererAdapterMs: Wall-clock CPU time (ms) in adaptInfrastructureGraphToRenderDescriptors and validateInfrastructureRenderDescriptors.
metricDefinitions.planarSurfaceResolutionMs: Wall-clock CPU time (ms) in resolveAndValidatePlanarPolygons performing 2D Boolean ownership resolution and elevation separation for landuse, parks, and water.
metricDefinitions.roadGeometryGenerationMs: Wall-clock CPU time (ms) in buildGraphAtGradeRoadGeometries constructing at-grade road and junction BufferGeometries.
metricDefinitions.railwayGeometryGenerationMs: Wall-clock CPU time (ms) in buildRailwayInfrastructure constructing ballast, 3D instanced sleepers/bearers, 3D rails, and procedural UV ribbons.
metricDefinitions.fullSceneGeometryGenerationMs: Wall-clock CPU time (ms) in GeometryBuilder.buildScene generating all 3D scene groups, materials, and spatial chunks.
metricDefinitions.sceneResourceDisposalMs: Wall-clock CPU time (ms) in BuiltSceneGeometry.dispose() releasing all owned Three.js BufferGeometries, Materials, and Textures.
metricDefinitions.cpuBufferMemoryMB: Exact deterministic sum (MB) of JavaScript TypedArray byteLengths across all active BufferGeometry vertex attributes, index buffers, and InstancedMesh matrices.
metricDefinitions.frameIntervalMs: Browser requestAnimationFrame-to-requestAnimationFrame wall-clock interval (ms). Distinct from CPU render call duration and GPU execution time.
metricDefinitions.effectiveMedianFps: Steady-state frame cadence derived from median frameIntervalMs (1000 / medianFrameIntervalMs).
metricDefinitions.cpuFrameRenderTimeMs: Synchronous CPU main-thread execution duration (ms) of Three.js WebGLRenderer.render(scene, camera) per frame.
metricDefinitions.gpuFrameRenderTimeMs: Asynchronous GPU command execution duration (ms) measured via WebGL2 EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 when supported and non-disjoint; explicitly null when unsupported or running on software rasterizers.
metricDefinitions.webglDrawCallsPerFrame: Actual WebGL draw calls issued per frame recorded from Three.js gl.info.render.calls immediately after gl.render().
metricDefinitions.renderedTrianglesPerFrame: Actual triangles submitted to WebGL per frame recorded from Three.js gl.info.render.triangles immediately after gl.render().

memoryMeasurementNotes: cpuBufferMemoryMB measures exact TypedArray byteLengths allocated on owned Three.js BufferGeometries and InstancedMesh instance matrices; it is 100% deterministic across runs.

v8HeapMemory (process.memoryUsage) and browser performance.memory reflect V8 garbage collector timing, JIT compilation caches, and allocator fragmentation. Even when Node.js is launched with --expose-gc, V8 heap deltas are approximate indicators rather than strict byte-accurate allocations.
lifecycleAudit (ownedGeometriesAfterDispose, ownedMaterialsAfterDispose, and WebGL gl.info.memory.geometries) provides the authoritative deterministic check for Three.js / WebGL resource leaks.
